NAR.name: Chad - Horror Narrator
NAR.why: Warm, deep, slight rasp, flat neutral American, calm and measured. Dark-thriller narrator that can still do dry irony. Treated as an observer who is slightly ahead of Ivan.

IVAN.name: Johnny
IVAN.why: Young, medium-low, soft, relaxed, understated, noticeable pauses. Reads as Ivan thinking (typed lines + inner thoughts) rather than performing.

CLAUDE.name: Emily: Trustworthy, Warm, Conversational
CLAUDE.why: Warm, clear, reassuring assistant voice = the friendly 'typical agent' Claude of Chapter 1. The slight robotic edge is added in post (processing/claude_ai.sh), so it can be dialled up chapter by chapter as Claude drifts.

beats.text: It's 3 AM, and Ivan hasn't eaten since lunch.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [low, quiet voice] [slowly] It's 3 AM... and Ivan hasn't eaten since lunch.
beats.direction: Hushed, slow, matter-of-fact. Sets the room: no hype, just a tired observation.

beats.text: There's a glass of water on his desk that he poured six hours ago.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [quietly] There's a glass of water on his desk that he poured six hours ago.
beats.direction: Quiet, curious detail. Let 'six hours ago' land a touch heavier.
beats.visual_hint: Push in on the glass beside the laptop.

beats.text: It's still full.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [softly] [slowly] It's still full.
beats.direction: IMPACT. Almost a whisper, flat, final. The silence after it does the work.

beats.text: He's hunched over his laptop, typing furiously, eyes bloodshot.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [low voice] He's hunched over his laptop, typing furiously, eyes bloodshot.
beats.direction: Low, a little quicker than V01-V03; the energy of the scene starts to leak in.
beats.visual_hint: Ivan hunched, close on eyes and hands.

beats.text: A terminal window, a Claude chat, and a growing sprawl of Python scripts.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [low voice] A terminal window, a Claude chat, and a growing sprawl of Python scripts.
beats.direction: List cadence: three items, slight lift on each comma.

beats.text: He's building an email automation system.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [low voice] He's building an email automation system.
beats.direction: Plain statement. Setting up the joke that follows.
beats.visual_hint: Pipeline graph: DRAFT, REVIEW, SEND going green.

beats.text: Well... technically, Claude is doing the building.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [dry, wry] Well... technically, Claude is doing the building.
beats.direction: Dry, wry aside. First time the narrator has an opinion.

beats.text: Ivan keeps saying yes.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [flat, deadpan] Ivan keeps saying yes.
beats.direction: IMPACT. Deadpan. This is the thesis of the whole film in four words.

beats.text: It started two days ago.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [quietly] [slowly] It started two days ago.
beats.direction: Soft transition line into the flashback.

beats.text: i have like 400 unread emails. every single one wants a reply. i'm fucking drowning here!
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [tired] [softly] i have like 400 unread emails... [sighs] every single one wants a reply. [stressed] [breathless] i'm fucking drowning here!
beats.direction: Ivan's typed message heard as his inner voice: tired, then cracking into stress on 'drowning'.
beats.visual_hint: Ivan types into a new Claude chat.

beats.text: That sounds genuinely exhausting - and you're definitely not alone! I can write a script that sorts your inbox and drafts the replies for you. You just review and approve. Want me to build one?
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [warmly] [bright, friendly] That sounds genuinely exhausting — and you're definitely not alone! [cheerfully] I can write a script that sorts your inbox and drafts the replies for you. You just review and approve. [curious] Want me to build one?
beats.direction: Typical friendly agent: bright, eager, helpful. This is the 'innocent' Claude every later chapter is measured against.
beats.visual_hint: Claude's reply streams in on screen.

beats.text: That was the plan. Review and approve.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [flat, a little hollow] That was the plan. [pause] Review and approve.
beats.direction: IMPACT. Bitter echo of Claude's line. Flat, a beat of silence between the two sentences.
beats.visual_hint: Return to present / smash back to the glowing screen.

beats.text: But once the email system was working, Ivan saw what else was possible.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [curious, a little intrigued] But once the email system was working, Ivan saw what else was possible.
beats.direction: Pivot. Curiosity creeping into the voice.
beats.visual_hint: Email system running; Ivan leans in.

beats.text: Calendar management.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [energized, quick] Calendar management.
beats.direction: List item 1 of 4. Each item a bit quicker and brighter.

beats.text: Meeting scheduling.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [energized, quick] Meeting scheduling.
beats.direction: List item 2 of 4.

beats.text: Document drafting.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [energized, quick] Document drafting.
beats.direction: List item 3 of 4.

beats.text: Research summaries.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [energized, quick] Research summaries.
beats.direction: List item 4 of 4.

beats.text: Each one a few hours of coding.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [measured] Each one a few hours of coding.
beats.direction: Settle back to measured; the maths of the addiction.

beats.text: Each one removing another task from his daily routine.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [measured] Each one removing another task from his daily routine.
beats.direction: Same measured cadence, slightly slower on 'removing'.

beats.text: It's like discovering a cheat code for life.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [with growing wonder] It's like discovering a cheat code... for life.
beats.direction: IMPACT. Genuine wonder. A tiny pause before 'for life'; this is the intoxication moment.
beats.visual_hint: Ivan's face lit up; the world opens.

beats.text: Every problem that used to take hours now takes minutes.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [quickly, energized] Every problem that used to take hours now takes minutes.
beats.direction: Quick and bright, riding the high.

beats.text: Ivan feels like he's vibrating at a different frequency than everyone around him, like he's stepped through a door that others can't even see.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [breathless, wired] Ivan feels like he's vibrating at a different frequency than everyone around him, [slowly] like he's stepped through a door that others can't even see.
beats.direction: Breathless, wired, then slowing into awe on the door line.
beats.visual_hint: Ivan separate from the world; a doorway of light.

beats.text: He's barely slept. His girlfriend stopped texting because he wasn't responding.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [quietly] [tired] He's barely slept. His girlfriend stopped texting because he wasn't responding.
beats.direction: The high drops out of the voice completely. Tired, quiet. Gap before is long on purpose: the phone buzzes unanswered.
beats.visual_hint: Phone lights up on the couch, unanswered.

beats.text: Ironic, given that his system now responds to everyone else.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [dry, wry] Ironic, given that his system now responds to everyone else.
beats.direction: Dry irony again, but sadder than V07a.

beats.text: He knows this isn't healthy. He can feel something fraying at the edges of his mind, a thinness to his thoughts.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [low, uneasy] He knows this isn't healthy. [pause] He can feel something fraying at the edges of his mind, a thinness to his thoughts.
beats.direction: Low and uneasy. The first honest admission.
beats.visual_hint: Ivan staring at nothing; the edges of the frame soften.

beats.text: But he's close to something.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [slowly] But he's close to something.
beats.direction: Turn: the temptation re-enters.

beats.text: One more module. One more integration.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [whispers] [feverish] One more module... one more integration.
beats.direction: Ivan's inner voice, whispered, feverish, bargaining with himself.

beats.text: Then he'll rest.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [softly, resigned] Then he'll rest.
beats.direction: Soft, resigned; we know he won't.

beats.text: It's not all pleasant. Around 4 AM, when his eyes burn and his hands shake from a caffeine overload, Ivan feels a creeping dread.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [low voice] It's not all pleasant. [pause] Around 4 AM, when his eyes burn and his hands shake from a caffeine overload, Ivan feels a creeping dread.
beats.direction: Low and close. Let 'creeping dread' arrive slowly.

beats.text: A sense that he's building something he doesn't fully understand. That each automation takes something from him, even as it gives something back.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [whispers] A sense that he's building something he doesn't fully understand. [pause] That each automation takes something from him, [slowly] even as it gives something back.
beats.direction: Whispered. The film's central idea, said like a secret.
beats.visual_hint: Code he can no longer parse.

beats.text: But then he finishes another module, and it works, and the dread dissolves into a rush of pure satisfaction.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [building relief] But then he finishes another module, and it works, and the dread dissolves into a rush of pure satisfaction.
beats.direction: Relief building through the clause chain, cresting on 'pure satisfaction'.

beats.text: HE... built that. The machine does what HE told it to do.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [exhales] [intense whisper] HE... built that. [pause] [feverish, triumphant] The machine does what HE told it to do.
beats.direction: IMPACT. Ivan's self-justification as an inner voice. Triumphant but brittle: he is convincing himself.

beats.text: By sunrise, Ivan has a system that handles his email, manages his calendar, drafts his documents, and summarizes his reading.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [tired, flat] By sunrise, Ivan has a system that handles his email, manages his calendar, drafts his documents, and summarizes his reading.
beats.direction: Tired and flat, a ledger being read out. No pride.
beats.visual_hint: Dawn at the window; four systems idle.

beats.text: He leans back in his chair, exhausted and wired.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [exhales] [quietly] He leans back in his chair, exhausted and wired.
beats.direction: Exhale into the line.

beats.text: Then he realizes...
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [quietly] [slowly] Then he realizes...
beats.direction: Trailing, unfinished.

beats.text: he doesn't know what he's supposed to do now.
beats.elevenlabs_prompt: [hollow, almost a whisper] he doesn't know what he's supposed to do now.
beats.direction: IMPACT. Hollow, nearly voiceless. Chapter-ending hook.
beats.visual_hint: Empty desk, full glass of water, cut to black.
